name: iter_conditions_map
description: CONDITIONS MAP - under which conditions does targeted (guided, warm-start) selection beat random selection when the loop runs for 8 iterations? Crosses the paper's two dominant coverage controls (rehearsal mix alpha, kernel width sigma) with the two levers that govern whether a REAL deficit survives past round 1: the induced gap radius and the candidate scarcity inside the gap (pool_deficit). At deficit 0 the gap is a one-shot target - 100 uniform candidates fill it in round 1 and guidance has nothing left to aim at; at 0.9 the gap stays under-represented in the pool, the fixed-dataset industrial premise. New-only regime, warm-start, 5 seeds.
